question: Spherical aberration is a defect in spherical mirrors where marginal rays and paraxial rays do not converge at the same point. Paraxial rays are defined as rays that:

options.A: Are far from the principal axis
options.B: Make a large angle with the principal axis
options.C: Are close to the principal axis and make small angles with it
options.D: Pass through the centre of curvature
